difficult_conversation_ai_check.recommitment_used_verbatim: Yes — but I need greater clarity about my role and responsibilities.
key_excerpts: Recommitment Response: Yes — but I need greater clarity about my role and responsibilities.

What Not to Lose Sight Of: The goal here is not to keep TEST on the board at any cost. It is to reach honest clarity about whether she can carry active responsibility right now, on terms that are honest for both her and the organization.

What You Need to Understand: What specifically she means by 'greater clarity' — whether the gap is about her day-to-day responsibilities, committee scope, what decisions she is expected to make, or how her work connects to the broader organization.

Move from interest to responsibility: 'If the organization provides you with a written role description, a defined committee scope, and an onboarding refresher — and you take ownership of the community engagement working group — are you ready to commit to that as an active board member? I want a yes that you can stand behind, not a yes to keep the conversation comfortable.'

Close: After this conversation, record the actual conclusion — what she committed to, what remains open, and what the next step is — in the Conversation Conclusion field. Do not rely on memory or assume the form response reflects the final decision.

critical.issue: Live Claude generation takes ~65-70 seconds end-to-end which EXCEEDS the public Kubernetes ingress ~60s timeout, resulting in a 502 Bad Gateway HTML page being returned to any external caller (verified reproducibly). Same call via internal http://localhost:8001 succeeds in ~66s with a valid 200 JSON response. Portfolio generation (~30s) does not hit this ceiling. Users initiating a Difficult Conversation Script from the browser will see a 502 error even though the material is being created in the database. The route already saves the material before responding, but the client never receives the material_id and cannot navigate to it.

minor.issue: When called with thin intake data (organization_name only, mission/direction_12_24/board_help_accomplish empty), Claude correctly avoids fabrication but ALSO drops the organization name entirely from the script prose (uses 'the board' / 'the organization' generically). Consider adding a small instruction to reference the organization by name at least once when only the name is available.

integration_issues.issue: Because the backend call exceeds ingress timeout, the UI will show a 502/network error even when generation ultimately succeeds server-side. User has no way to know material was saved.

action_items: HIGH: Reduce latency of /reactivation/board-members/{id}/conversation-script or the ingress timeout. Options: (a) return the material_id immediately and stream/poll the generated content asynchronously (recommended), (b) reduce the schema size or max_tokens for the conversation-script generation type so Claude responds in <45s, (c) request an ingress timeout bump for this route. Current 502 makes the feature unusable from the browser even though the backend is functioning correctly.
MINOR: In /reactivation/routes conversation-script prompt, when intake has only organization_name populated, encourage referencing the org by name at least once in the generated script.

critical_code_review_comments: reactivation_routes.py:522-525 — generation is a blocking 65s Claude call inside the request handler; production ingress cuts at ~60s so the whole endpoint is effectively broken over the public URL. Backend saves the material AFTER the model returns (line 528), so the material IS created but the client sees 502. Consider a job-queue pattern: POST returns 202 + material_id immediately, background worker fills structured content, client polls GET /reactivation/materials/{id} until status Draft.

rca of the issue: conversation-script 502 root cause: reactivation_routes.py generate_conversation_script(...) awaits generate_structured() synchronously; Claude Sonnet 4 output for the reactivation_conversation_script schema (~13 nested string/array/object sections) consistently takes 60-70s. Kubernetes ingress (nginx) enforces a ~60s upstream_response_timeout on this preview environment, so external callers get an HTML 502 Bad Gateway page while the FastAPI worker completes the request and DOES persist the material in generated_materials (verified: material b9b30ccc-fe5d-4d85-b511-f1e51fb300c5 is present in Mongo after the external 502). Mitigation: (1) return 202 + material_id immediately and populate structured content asynchronously; poll via existing GET /reactivation/materials/{id}. (2) Alternatively cap Claude output_tokens or split the script into two smaller schema chunks so total time <45s. Reproduction: run POST /api/reactivation/board-members/3a8be71b-b8c7-41f4-a87e-b82b28376a68/conversation-script against the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host — 502 in ~60s; same call to http://localhost:8001/api/... succeeds in ~66s with full JSON body.
